scope: Historical supplementary account tests; does not replace the required Web gate

runs.label: candidate
failed_cases: the account panel hosts no 「我的资源」 group and no personal entry
the account panel keeps exactly the retained entries, in order
the account trigger describes account settings, not personal resources
preferences close cleanly at login and remain available in legacy and public modes
startup check failure stays neutral; a visible retry enters database mode and initializes only once
legacy responses distinguish password protection and explicit anonymous access
HTTP, business and incomplete check responses cannot masquerade as anonymous access
legacy login normalizes the status-only success contract and serializes repeated submissions
valid version survives invalid responses, and a brand repaint changes only the version label
chat initialization restores scoped selections and waits for the Agent catalog before session reads
the avatar file input lives outside the repainted disc in chat.html
the account panel keeps its region order and adds no personal page tab
the console top bar does not repeat the logout, appearance or language entries
